title: Put your club's biggest nights in order | FAN LIFE Timeline
description:
You remember the night. Do you remember the year? Timeline on FAN LIFE, shown with AEK Athens: Timeline takes the dates your club lived through: finals, titles, nights in Europe. Each card is a real moment from the archive. Your job is to put it in the right place in history. Get the order right and the line grows. Get it wrong and the archive shows you where it really belongs.

▶ Play it: https://fanlife.dubelteam.com/clubs/aek-athens/timeline

Narration is synthetic. #FANLIFE #FootballGames #FootballFans
